reference_fragrances.db.provenance: Copied from the workspace Newss project; original upstream source and license were not established.
reference_fragrances.db.prohibited_claim: Market coverage, sensory truth, or regulatory authority

moga_ingredients.db.prohibited_claim: Current price, inventory, safety, or supplier evidence

safe_ingredient_catalog.json.allowed_use: Prototype candidate screening and semantic-profile optimization
safe_ingredient_catalog.json.prohibited_claim: Supplier quotation, complete IFRA compliance, or human sensory accuracy

supplier_registry.json.allowed_use: Fail-closed proof that no supplier evidence is bundled

scientific_properties.db.provenance: 29 CAS-linked single-material PubChem records plus four published-composition-derived natural-material descriptor centroids; five directly sourced compound odor thresholds are retained with row-level URLs
scientific_properties.db.allowed_use: Physics-informed headspace, odor-activity, temporal-mixture simulation and explicit uncertainty priors
scientific_properties.db.prohibited_claim: Complete physicochemical coverage, receptor prediction, supplier identity, or human olfactory accuracy

nonhuman_data_hub.db.provenance: Built from 75 non-human local, schema and public-reference sources, including five fingerprinted EPA CompTox bulk sources; human validation assets and odor-threshold observations are excluded from this hub
nonhuman_data_hub.db.allowed_use: Non-human lineage search, molecular descriptor and EPA identifier/product-use/toxicology reference lookup, weak historical co-occurrence priors and offline synthetic training inventory
nonhuman_data_hub.db.prohibited_claim: Human sensory evidence, complete global coverage, supplier qualification, legal compliance or measured-property authority for unverified rows

epa_comptox_extract.db.provenance: Catalog-filtered extract of official EPA DSSTox December 2025, CPDat v4.0, ToxRefDB v3.0 and ToxValDB v9.7.0 bulk downloads; all five source URLs, versions, byte sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints retained in source_files
epa_comptox_extract.db.allowed_use: CAS/DTXSID and structure linkage, product-use evidence, non-human toxicology screening and model-feature research
epa_comptox_extract.db.prohibited_claim: Human olfactory accuracy, automatic safety approval, IFRA or legal compliance, supplier qualification or commercial release

natural_material_compositions.json.provenance: Published GC-MS single-sample compositions for sweet orange, lavender and patchouli, plus NTP-reported ISO chromatographic ranges for Virginia cedarwood; source table, URL, license and access date retained
natural_material_compositions.json.allowed_use: Reference molecular-component expansion and UVCB descriptor priors
natural_material_compositions.json.prohibited_claim: Lot-specific GC-MS, whole-material vapor pressure or odor threshold, supplier identity or release specification

odor_descriptor_projections.json.provenance: Project-authored perfumery engineering projections; no third-party rows are copied
odor_descriptor_projections.json.allowed_use: Natural-language intent parsing, transparent coarse-profile projection and fail-closed descriptor recognition
odor_descriptor_projections.json.prohibited_claim: Measured sensory equivalence, receptor ground truth or 90 percent human olfactory accuracy

odor_threshold_registry.json.provenance: Abraham 2012 gas-phase human ODT records from the MIT-licensed Pyrfume processed archive; only exact RDKit structure matches retained
odor_threshold_registry.json.allowed_use: Compound-level historical odor-activity prior with explicit ppmv units
odor_threshold_registry.json.prohibited_claim: Generated-formula human validation, text-to-odor accuracy or 90% olfactory equivalence

r2_ingredient_components.npz.provenance: RDKit 217-descriptor registry for 34 formulation-ready materials expanded to 72 exact synthetic or published-reference natural components
r2_ingredient_components.npz.allowed_use: Frozen R2 mixture-similarity inference inside the descriptor and applicability contract
r2_ingredient_components.npz.prohibited_claim: Unknown-lot natural composition, receptor response, direct sensory truth or global ingredient coverage

r2_ingredient_components_manifest.json.provenance: Build manifest for the R2 component registry, including source hashes, descriptor contract and composition coverage

physsim_r2_checkpoint.pt.provenance: 162,059-parameter JCIM R2 PhysSim-Core checkpoint trained on Snitz 2013 under the recorded protocol
physsim_r2_checkpoint.pt.allowed_use: Diagnostic historical mixture-similarity output only; final formulation score weight remains zero until a ratio/concentration/time/headspace capability contract and independent artifact trust are both satisfied
physsim_r2_checkpoint.pt.prohibited_claim: Literal learned physical observables, text-to-odor ground truth or 90% human olfactory equivalence

physsim_r2_checkpoint_seed_20260713.pt.provenance: Second 162,059-parameter JCIM R2 member trained with fixed seed 20260713 under the same descriptor and transfer contract
physsim_r2_checkpoint_seed_20260713.pt.allowed_use: Diagnostic ensemble member and historical-label epistemic disagreement estimate; not authorized to alter a formulation score
physsim_r2_checkpoint_seed_20260713.pt.prohibited_claim: Independent human validation, literal physical observables or unbounded extrapolation

physsim_r2_ensemble_manifest.json.provenance: Two-seed weights selected by a coarse development-only balanced molecule/scaffold objective, strong-baseline final validation and split-conformal uncertainty contract
physsim_r2_ensemble_manifest.json.allowed_use: Fail-closed diagnostic loading, OOD disagreement and historical-mixture prediction interval; not a formulation-score authorization
physsim_r2_ensemble_manifest.json.prohibited_claim: Text-to-formula or human olfactory uncertainty calibration

physsim_r2_runtime_weights.npz.provenance: Portable NumPy export of the two hash-bound frozen R2 checkpoint state dictionaries; serialized source checkpoints remain in the research tree but are excluded from runtime distributions
physsim_r2_runtime_weights.npz.allowed_use: Pickle-free and torch-free reproduction of the diagnostic frozen R2 forward pass
physsim_r2_runtime_weights.npz.prohibited_claim: New training evidence, concentration-aware formulation capability or human olfactory accuracy

physsim_r2_runtime_manifest.json.provenance: Build-time binding of portable NumPy tensors to the exact ensemble manifest, member checkpoint hashes and descriptor contract, with six deterministic Torch-to-NumPy equivalence cases
physsim_r2_runtime_manifest.json.allowed_use: Runtime artifact integrity, shape contract and dependency-light numeric inference verification

human_mixture_calibration.json.provenance: Protocol-aware overlap calibration fitted only on the predeclared Bushdid calibration partition, with four-fold cross-conformal residuals; historical final labels are evaluation-only and the model was developed after unblinding
human_mixture_calibration.json.allowed_use: Retrospective odd-one-out discrimination audit for the exact hash-bound Bushdid stimulus and vial-dilution protocol; ordinary RecipeLine formulas must abstain
human_mixture_calibration.json.prohibited_claim: Perfume formula smell similarity, unequal-ratio extrapolation or 90 percent human olfactory equivalence

concentration_response_model.joblib.provenance: Ravia behavior_1 global dilution-to-perceived-intensity ridge response fitted after molecule-disjoint evaluation
concentration_response_model.joblib.allowed_use: Training provenance and offline equivalence audit only; this serialized source artifact is excluded from runtime wheels
concentration_response_model.joblib.prohibited_claim: Molecule-specific concentration response, mixture similarity or human formula validation

concentration_response_runtime.json.provenance: JSON numeric export of the validated Ravia concentration-only scaler and ridge coefficients, cryptographically bound to the retained source training artifact
concentration_response_runtime.json.allowed_use: Pickle-free NumPy diagnostic dilution-response inference and independently signed deployment authorization
concentration_response_runtime.json.prohibited_claim: Molecule-specific concentration response, mixture similarity or human formula validation

concentration_response_manifest.json.provenance: Molecule-disjoint validation, unit contract, source hashes, rejected structure-specific candidate record and a hash-bound JSON numeric runtime exported from the retained source model
concentration_response_manifest.json.allowed_use: Fail-closed diagnostic loading and independent-signature authorization contract
concentration_response_manifest.json.prohibited_claim: Accuracy outside the named Ravia intensity experiment

continuous_improvement_policy.json.provenance: Project-curated fail-closed champion/challenger policy with prospective external, source/molecule/scaffold-cold, bootstrap, portable-runtime and detached-signature gates
continuous_improvement_policy.json.allowed_use: Autonomous research challenger evaluation, shadow promotion and independently authorized production selection
continuous_improvement_policy.json.prohibited_claim: Self-generated sensory truth, unsupervised production promotion, or 90 percent human olfactory accuracy

physsim_r2_manifest.json.provenance: Checkpoint source hashes, runtime, component-cold, strict disjoint, external transfer and ensemble calibration release contract
physsim_r2_manifest.json.allowed_use: Fail-closed checkpoint loading and approved-weight selection
physsim_r2_manifest.json.prohibited_claim: Performance beyond the named datasets and split protocols
